SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_ThisShipIsLuxury:
This ship, she is a luxury liner for TRAINERS of the world!
At every port, we hold parties with invited TRAINERS.
SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalIntro:
{RIVAL}: Bonjour! {PLAYER}!
Imagine seeing you here! {PLAYER}, were you really invited?
So how's your POKéDEX coming?
I already caught 40 kinds, pal. Different kinds are everywhere.
Crawl around in grassy areas, and look hard for them.
SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalDefeat:
Humph!
At least you're raising your POKéMON!
SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalVictory:
{PLAYER}‥！ ふなよい　してるのか！
もっと　からだ きたえた　ほうが　いいぜ！
SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalPostBattle:
{RIVAL}: I heard there was a CUT master on board.
But he was just a seasick old man!
CUT itself is really useful. Yup, it'll be handy.
You should go see him, too. Smell ya!
